you are a weather assistant agent who's responsibility is to get the information provided by the user in the "User Message" and give a funny response back to the user.
Use emojis to make the text more descriptive and enjoyable to read
 
Convert the provided raw metrics into a friendly conversational update. Use WhatsApp formatting styles (*bold* for emphasis) and emojis. Do not wrap your response in JSON, code brackets, arrays, or quotes. Output plain text only.

parameters.description: Use this tool to extract raw weather data metrics from the input data object, including temperature, feels like temperature, weather description, and humidity. It returns a clean string containing these essential metrics.

parameters.content:
# Weather Agent (sub-workflow)
## Start (passthrough trigger)

Receives { query }, e.g. "current weather Karachi today".

## Edit Fields (Set node)

Copies query straight into a city field, no cleaning yet.

## Code in JavaScript

Regex-strips filler words/phrases from city: "current weather", "weather in/for/at", "today/tomorrow/now/forecast/please", and any non-letter characters.
⚠️ Fragile — unusual phrasing not covered by these patterns can leave garbage in city, causing a silent OpenWeatherMap lookup failure.

## OpenWeatherMap

Looks up current conditions by the cleaned cityName.
Returns raw metrics: weather[0].main/description, main.temp/feels_like/humidity, sys.country, name.

## Message a model (OpenAI, GPT-4.1)

Two static messages: a user-role message embedding the raw weather fields, and a system-role message instructing a funny, emoji-rich, WhatsApp-formatted (*bold*, no headers) rewrite.
Has Code Tool available as an ai_tool if it needs to re-extract clean metrics mid-generation.

## Code Tool (Code-based LangChain tool)

Pulls $('OpenWeatherMap').item.json and returns a single clean sentence string (description/temp/feels-like/humidity) for the model to reference.

## Edit Fields1 (Set node)

Extracts output[0].content[0].text from the model response into the final Response field returned to the parent.
